name: JUSTMAKER
summary: Amazon filament brand with a broad 1 kg range on cardboard spools: PLA, PLA Carbon Fiber Lite, PETG (Pro/PETG+, Rapid, Matte, Glass Fiber), ABS and ABS+, ASA and TPU in 95A and 64D. Single spools run about $15-25/kg, TPU 64D up to about $34/kg. The Amazon seller is a Suzhou technology company; the extruder is unknown.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: 1 kg on an 'upgrade cardboard spool' plus a 2 kg spool; about $15-25/kg.

product_lines.name: ABS and ABS+
product_lines.notes: ABS Matte, ABS Transparent (incl. low-odour and matte transparent) and ABS+, 1 kg, $18.99-25.99.
